thread:
sara: Hey team — AcmeSec wants a fully air-gapped on‑prem POC. Questions: (1) packaging format they can ship on USB, (2) upgrade cadence / how we handle hotfixes, (3) rollback path if an update breaks things, and (4) any licensing/price delta for offline patches. Can ops/eng confirm?

ben: Quick summary: we support signed minibundles + a small agent-side installer that applies deltas. For strict airgap, workflow is: produce signed bundle -> customer imports signer key into local notary -> apply bundle. Hotfixes can be pushed as delta patches; if they refuse delta, full minibundle re-import.

marta: Adding constraints: (a) minibundles must be <= 10GB for USB shipment by default (we can do larger but requires SOW), (b) delta patches require agent v1.3+ (we've got a staged rollout), (c) we verify signatures against a customer-imported public key or HSM-backed key if they're using KMS/HSM.

ben: sample verification command we give customers: 
```
redwood-verify --bundle path/to/bundle.tar.gz --pubkey /opt/acme/public.pem --checksum sha256
```

ryan: Ops notes on network/proxy: no egress required if they bootstrap signer locally. If they want our telemetry opt-in disabled, we can do a build flag. Also need to confirm firewall ports if they plan to use remote notary (443 outbound).

sara: Good. Pricing: Acme asked if offline patching costs extra. What's our standard?

marta: Pricing: hosted updates included in subscription. For air-gapped customers we split: (1) standard monthly support + (2) per-SOW engineering for large-bundle or one-off signed bundle delivery. Typical add-on is a one-time packaging/ signing fee (we've quoted $8k–15k historically) and optional per-bundle ops fee for signed hotfixes. I'll attach formal numbers after confirm scope.

ben: For the POC (6 weeks) we usually waive the SOW fee if it's a standard minibundle and they accept the delta workflow. If they insist on repeatedly signed full bundles for every patch, we bill per-bundle ops time.

sara: They also sent a security questionnaire asking about key rotation and provenance. What do we tell them?

marta: Key rotation: we support rotating the notary key. Process: generate new key locally or using KMS, import to local notary, sign next bundle with new key. We keep audit logs on the appliance for every verification event. Provenance: bundles include manifest with git SHA and build timestamp. Example manifest snippet we provide: 
```
manifest_version: 1
build_sha: 7f3d2a1
built_at: 2026-02-11T15:22:00Z
components: [runtime, model-weights-v2, agent]
```

ben: Also callout: quantized model artifacts (if included) increase bundle size. Recommend shipping model separately or using delta quantization patches to keep size down.

ryan: Rollback path: agent keeps last-good snapshot and can revert to previous bundle automatically if healthcheck fails during canary. Canary procedure we propose: import bundle -> apply to 5% nodes -> run smoke evals -> auto rollback on regression. For airgap, smoke evals run locally against customer-provided test prompts.

sara: Can we outline the POC runbook for Acme? Short bullets I can drop into the SOW.

marta: Runbook bullets: 
- Deliver signed minibundle (<=10GB) on USB or secure transfer.
- Customer imports public key into local notary and validates bundle.
- Apply bundle to canary cohort (5%); run smoke eval set (provided by Acme).
- Monitor logs + local healthchecks for 30m; if pass, roll out remaining nodes.
- If failure, agent auto-reverts to previous snapshot; ops notified.
- For hotfixes during POC: provide delta patch or full minibundle; if full minibundle requested, ops schedules delivery window.

deploy-bot: artifact-signer: bundle 2026-02-12T15:30:21Z (sha256: a1b2c3...) signed with redwood-ci-key. CI link: https://ci.redwood/artefacts/321

sara: Nice. Action items: @marta to send formal pricing + SOW template, @ben to prepare verification snippet for docs, @ryan to draft the canary smoke checklist. I'll share runbook with Acme tomorrow.

ben: ack :thumbsup:

marta: I'll draft numbers and include optional HSM/KMS integration costs. Expect a note by EOD PST.

ryan: I'll add the smoke eval prompts and the minimal healthchecks (latency, token-loss, rpc error rate).

sara: Perfect — thanks folks. I'll update thread with customer follow-up.
